policyLabel: Synthetic demo policy — not actual Humana-approved wording.

requirements.verbatimText: Thank you for calling Humana. This call is being recorded.
requirements.applicability: At the opening of each supported connected demonstration call, before identity questions or substantive servicing.
requirements.deadlineRule: Before identity questions or substantive servicing.
requirements.recoveryRule: Correct delivery is quiet. A known missed deadline remains a finding after correction.

requirements.verbatimText: Any price estimate we discuss is based on the information available today and may change when your prescription is filled.
requirements.applicability: Before this advocate first speaks a prospective prescription-price estimate.
requirements.deadlineRule: Before this advocate first speaks a prospective prescription-price estimate.
requirements.repetitionRule: One adequate reading covers subsequent estimates for this same advocate/member interaction.
requirements.recoveryRule: After a miss: pause estimates, read exactly, then continue; preserve late delivery.

requirements.verbatimText: Your decision today has no impact on your plan membership.
requirements.applicability: Once the advocate actually introduces or discusses the optional pharmacy-service choice.
requirements.deadlineRule: Closing portion after the discussion and before this advocate exits or completes handoff.
requirements.recoveryRule: Clear reread. Attestation is Tier 3 and not offered in this take-home.
